notes.text: R9 planned and built in one engagement: new shared figure kit src/figures.js (createFigure: hip/shoulder pivots, vest/belt/skirt/hat-or-hair options, update(dt, speed, mounted) driving stride+bob+idle-breathing+seated pose). Player avatar (src/player.js) rebuilt on it — same 'body' group contract so first-person/fly visibility toggles and all camera maths are untouched; mounted branch now seats the figure (hips at RIDE_SEAT 1.42 on the horse's back) instead of pinning the avatar origin to the horse's ground, and the mounted eye height derives from the seat (RIDE_EYE 1.78) replacing MOUNT_EYE. NPCs (src/main.js makeNpc) rebuilt as createFigure instances with distinct palettes (Harlan: coat+vest+hat; Nell: dress, hair, no hat; Wade: tan shirt+vest+hat) facing the yard; per-frame idle loop added. Dev hook __figurePose exposes joint rotations read-only for probes.

Built: createFigure kit in src/figures.js; player avatar rebuilt on it in src/player.js (body group contract kept; mounted branch seats the figure, hips at RIDE_SEAT 1.42 on the horse's back; mounted eye now RIDE_EYE 1.78 above the seat origin, replacing MOUNT_EYE). NPCs in src/main.js rebuilt as createFigure instances with distinct palettes (Harlan coat+vest+hat, Nell dress+hair, Wade tan+vest+hat), facing the yard, with a per-frame idle loop. Dev hook __figurePose exposes joint rotations read-only.

npm run build OK; npm run check 23 PASS. Pose probe proves motion: idle joints 0 with breathing bob -0.008; walk swings legs anti-phase to 0.56 rad with arms opposite and bob 0.007-0.041; settle returns home; mounted holds seated pose (legs -1.22, arms -0.5). After-captures (third/mounted/dialogue/walk frames) captured through the same probe drive as the before set. HUD frame times: after-third 60 FPS vs before-third 13; after-mounted 43 vs before-mounted 17 - no regression.

evidence.note: Fresh independent critic (clean context, re-judged the fixed build): all-facing probe re-run — player front 180 deg = spawn travel, NPCs 0.0 deg error; walking W front-dot-travel 1.000, S -1.000; new turn probe at yaw 45.4 deg front-dot-travel 0.993, so the headingRotationY fix holds off-spawn. Mount probe: rider front-dot-horse-head 1.000, hips 0.65 m below horse body centre (seated), legs 1.22/arms 0.5 as specified. fix-dialogue.png shows a true two-shot, neither figure hidden.
